warnings: Candidates are not a verified seat inventory.
Cross-out detection is heuristic: inspect exclusions and missing/merged/split boxes.
Scanned labels use provisional D-numbers; no OCR or label guessing is performed.
limitations: Candidate count is not measured seat recall.
24 new interior-point references and 24 older polygon references were used during development, not held-out validation.
Residual loje details and incorrect candidates can remain outside the checked locations.
All seat identities and handwritten exclusions require review before publishing.
